data.one_liner: Tools and CLI scripts to sort, diff, merge, and manipulate .arb localization files.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of standalone functions and CLI commands to work with .arb translation files. It allows sorting, merging, diffing, and processing new keys in ARB files, as well as runtime language switching and dynamic loading via ArbClient.
use_when: You need to automate management, sorting, or merging of .arb translation files in your project.
You want a CLI utility to quickly add translation entries or generate missing metadata.
You need a helper for manual runtime language switching with Provider or BLoC.
avoid_when: You are looking for a comprehensive full-featured i18n localization framework without managing raw .arb files directly.
You use a state manager other than Provider/BLoC for the provided UI language selector helpers.
strengths: Handy CLI commands for sorting, adding entries, and listing ARB keys.
Standalone functions for diffing, merging, and sorting ARB files programmatically.
Includes runtime language switching helper widgets.
weaknesses: Runtime helpers are currently limited to Provider and BLoC out of the box.
Documentation for advanced setup relies partly on specific code patterns.
data.setup_notes: Can be activated globally via pub for CLI tools or added as a standard dependency.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Type-safe localization generator that offers an alternative way to handle translations without dealing directly with standard ARB files.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides out-of-the-box easy localization management using JSON, CSV, or YAML files with built-in runtime locale changes.
